name: Co-op
author: Ben
summary: Two players, one board, over Steam. Shared shop, own pieces, enemy plays twice. (beta)
description:
Play a run with a friend. One of you hosts, the other joins from their Steam friends list - no server, no port forwarding, it rides the Steam relay the game is already connected to. You share one board and one shop and each own your pieces (P1 red, P2 blue), with both cursors visible live. A round goes P1 moves, P2 moves, then the enemy moves twice - the doubled enemy turn is the game's own final-boss mechanism, so it behaves exactly like a vanilla double move.

The host is authoritative for everything that cannot be reproduced remotely: the seed, the enemy AI, the wallet, and the gambit collection - the host's unlocks are the run's unlocks, so P2 plays with the host's cards and gets their own collection back afterwards. Post-battle income is halved (rounded up) so two players do not earn double, and the win screen shows the split. Your single-player save is snapshotted when a co-op run starts and restored when it ends.

Still a beta: the Steam connection, the shared shop, both piece wheels and the gachapon are synced and tested, but pachinko and Twitch chaos mode are not mirrored yet. Both players need the same mod version - mismatches are refused at handshake rather than desyncing quietly.
